nodes.label: Knight Reference Sprite Sheet
nodes.description: Third-party asset-pack sprite sheet used as reference. Layout: 4 rows x 4 columns on solid black. Row 1 = front idle/walk, row 2 = back walk with blue cape, row 3 = side walk, row 4 = attack sequence (sword raised, horizontal slash with white motion arc, extended thrust, recovery/guard). Archetype: classic sword-and-shield knight in polished silver plate, blue cape, gold rampant lion on a blue heater shield. Same rig and pose set as the black knight sheet, recolored.
nodes.rationale: Reference for the canonical 4-row directional sheet convention (front / back / side / attack) that Thaira's character animation state machine is expected to consume.

nodes.label: Knight Archetype (sword and shield)
nodes.description: Armored frontline melee class: sword in the right hand, heraldic shield in the left, cape for the back-view silhouette.

nodes.label: Four-Row Directional Frame Grid
nodes.description: Sheet layout convention shared by these references: one row per facing (front, back, side) with a uniform-width walk/idle cycle, plus a final row of action/attack key poses. Columns within a row are evenly spaced frames of one loop.
nodes.rationale: Uniform cell size per row is what lets a sprite renderer index frames by (row = direction/state, column = frame number) instead of shipping per-frame metadata.

nodes.label: High-Detail 2.5D Pixel Art Style
nodes.description: Shared visual language across these reference sheets: chibi-leaning proportions with an oversized head/helmet, 3/4 top-down camera, heavy specular highlights and rim lighting, dark outlines, limited but rich palettes.
